# AutoHauz

> AutoHauz is an Australian used-car dealership. We advertise quality, inspected second-hand vehicles for sale and help buyers enquire, arrange finance, trade in their current car and book inspections. This is a used-car sales site, not a rental or car-hire platform.

Every vehicle is inspected before it is listed and its condition is documented, including imperfections. Prices are in Australian dollars (AUD) and are advertised sale prices; on-road costs such as stamp duty, registration and transfer fees may be additional unless a listing says "drive away". Vehicles are for purchase, not for hire.

## Inventory

- [All used cars for sale](https://autohauz.com.au/used-cars): the searchable stock list with make, model, body type, price, year and kilometre filters
- [Cars by make](https://autohauz.com.au/used-cars): make pages live at /used-cars/{make}, model pages at /used-cars/{make}/{model}
- [Cars by body type](https://autohauz.com.au/used-cars/body/suv): body-type pages live at /used-cars/body/{body-type} (suv, ute, hatch, sedan, wagon, van, people-mover)
- [Cars by budget](https://autohauz.com.au/used-cars/under-20000): budget pages live at /used-cars/under-{price}
- Vehicle detail pages live at /used-cars/{make}/{model}/{slug} and carry Car + Offer JSON-LD (AUD, UsedCondition, availability)

## Buying, selling and finance

- [How buying works](https://autohauz.com.au/how-it-works): the five steps from browsing to driving away
- [Sell your car](https://autohauz.com.au/sell-your-car): request a no-obligation offer for your current car
- [Trade in your car](https://autohauz.com.au/trade-in): put your current car towards your next one
- [Car finance](https://autohauz.com.au/finance): repayment estimator and finance enquiry (indicative only, not an offer of finance)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://autohauz.com.au/faqs): answers about inspections, warranty, finance and paperwork
